title: TrackerEvent
description: The event stream from the native Kotlin tracker to the Flutter UI. Student A produces these; Student B consumes them. Neither side may add, rename or remove a variant without a PR that changes this file first. Source: Terrastep plan section 13 (sampling states) and section 14 (client architecture).

SessionId.description: Client-generated session UUID. The server issues its own session id on POST /v1/sessions; carry both and never conflate them.

MonotonicMs.description: Milliseconds from an unspecified origin that never goes backwards, e.g. Android elapsedRealtimeNanos/1e6. Use this for ALL durations. A wall clock can be changed by the user and must never be used for elapsed time.

UtcIso.description: UTC instant, always with a trailing Z. Never a local time, never an offset.

SamplingState.description: The six states from plan section 13. 'boundary' means adjacent fixes and their uncertainty disagree about the cell; competitive attribution must be withheld, not guessed.

InterruptionReason.description: Plan section 13: a blocked or stopped service must produce an honest interruption notice, never fabricated continuity. This enum is that notice.

rule_version.description: Scoring ruleset this session will be judged under. Immutable once issued. See plan section 9.

step_counter_baseline.description: Cumulative step counter value at session start. Null when the device has no step sensor. A cumulative counter can reset after reboot and is NOT today's total - always pair it with boot_id.

boot_id.description: Identifies the current device boot. If this changes between two readings, the counter reset and the delta must be discarded, not credited.

accuracy_m.description: Reported horizontal accuracy in metres. Plan section 18: treat this as uncertainty, not as a boundary guarantee. When adjacent fixes disagree about the cell, withhold attribution.

speed_mps.description: Metres per second. Null when unavailable. Do NOT infer from consecutive positions - the phone reports it.

provider.description: Which source produced the fix. Needed to reason about budget-phone GPS quality by tier.

step_delta.description: Steps since the previous MotionUpdate. Plan section 12: never assign a large delta to whichever cell happens to be current when a delayed callback arrives. If the delta is implausible for the elapsed window, leave it unassigned to cells.

boot_id.description: Must match the boot_id of the preceding event. A mismatch means the counter reset; discard the delta.

motion_class.description: On-device activity classification when available. Used as ONE anti-cheat signal among several - never as sole proof.

distance_m.description: Metres. Base unit is always metres; the UI renders user-selected units. Computed from filtered valid positions only - never by summing stationary GPS jitter.

steps.description: Null if no step sensor. Estimated-from-distance steps must NEVER be placed here; they belong in a separate clearly-labelled field.

steps_estimated.description: Kept separate on purpose. Plan section 12: estimated steps must never masquerade as measured steps or become a fallback exploit for ranked play.

durable.description: True only if every sample reached the local encrypted store. If false, the UI must show a partial-session warning. This is the field that makes lost walks visible instead of silent.

interruptions.description: Every interruption that occurred during the session, in order.

recoverable.description: Whether tracking can resume without user action. Student B must surface this to the user either way - a silent gap is the worst outcome.

user_message.description: Plain-language explanation for the user. No blame, no medical framing.
